tools.name: find_delivered_price
tools.description: Finds the Shopify stores that deliver a product to a country and ranks them by the final total a shopper pays: item price, shipping to that country, the best confirmed code, sales tax or VAT, and import fees. tools.name: import_fee_rules
tools.description: Explains the sales tax, VAT, GST and import duty a shopper pays on goods ordered from abroad to a country, and how Lowcart counts them in totals. Covers the US, UK, Australia, New Zealand and every EU country. US duty depends on the product and where it was made: Lowcart estimates it for beauty prod
